name: How a ticket is built (the phase chain)
summary: The full /build-feature phase chain: ticket-supervisor (depth 0) takes a wired ticket and dispatches each NEEDED phase agent at depth 1 in priority order — status-checker, then the optional design phases (adr-author, architecture-diagram-author, it-po), architect-review, test-writer (TDD red), the coders (make it green), test-runner, documentation + change-scope review, pr-reviewer, then the AC/surface gates (ac-validator, user-surface-smoker, ac-fulfillment-gate, live-surface-tester), and finally commit and pull-request. The handoff medium is the ticket file plus each agent's sign-off comment (ok | handoff | blocker | question), which is what unblocks the next phase. Only agents whose `agents:` map entry is `needed` run; the rest are skipped. On a blocker, ticket-supervisor climbs the failure-adjudication ladder instead of advancing.

steps.label: Supervisor dispatches phases
steps.human: ticket-supervisor reads the ticket's `agents:` map and drives it through its phase agents in priority order, spawning the next `needed` agent at depth 1 and routing on the sign-off status it parses back.

steps.label: Status check (prio 1)
steps.human: status-checker reads the ticket state, current branch, and whether prior phases/commits already exist, so the drive starts from the real state.

steps.label: ADR (prio 2, conditional)
steps.human: adr-author writes an Architecture Decision Record — only when the ticket's `requires_adr` is set.

steps.label: Architecture diagram (prio 3, conditional)
steps.human: architecture-diagram-author writes or updates the C4 mermaid diagram — only when the ticket's `requires_diagram` is set.

steps.label: IT-PO enrichment (prio 3.5, conditional)
steps.human: it-po enriches the ACs' technical fields (assigned_agent, contracts, complexity) if they still need it before implementation.

steps.label: Architect review (prio 4)
steps.human: architect-review classifies the change's blast radius (small vs large) and writes an inline note or escalates, so coders know the structural impact before touching code.

steps.label: Test-writer — TDD red (prio 5)
steps.human: test-writer writes the failing test stubs from the ticket's `## Test Requirements`, runs them RED, and records a red_baseline — the contract the coders must turn green. Auto-skips for docs/config-only tickets.

steps.label: Coders make it green (prio 6-8)
steps.human: python-coder (6), sql-coder (7) and frontend-coder (8) implement against the red baseline, editing only files_touched, until every red_baseline test goes green.

steps.label: Test-runner (prio 9)
steps.human: test-runner picks the right suite for what changed, runs it, and returns a structured pass/fail report confirming the red baseline is now green.

steps.label: Documentation (prio 10, conditional)
steps.human: documentation-expert (and its how-to / reference / explanation sub-authors) writes or updates docs when the ticket calls for it.

steps.label: Change-scope review (prio 10)
steps.human: change-scope-reviewer compares the staged diff against files_touched / out_of_scope and flags any unexpected file as soft / hard / ambiguous.

steps.label: PR self-review (prio 11)
steps.human: pr-reviewer runs the review-pr toolkit over the diff, keeps only high-confidence findings, and escalates a medium cluster to Opus — the quality gate before the coverage gates.

steps.label: AC coverage gate (prio 11.5)
steps.human: ac-validator confirms every AC has concrete implementation AND test evidence in the diff before the commit lock.

steps.label: User-surface smoke (prio 11.5, conditional)
steps.human: user-surface-smoker invokes the user-facing surface end-to-end and asserts its side-effects — only when the ticket declares a `user_facing_surface`.

steps.label: AC fulfillment gate (prio 11.7)
steps.human: ac-fulfillment-gate verifies (and append-only auto-fixes) the AC store's work_status / implemented_by / covered_by so the store is accurate before commit.

steps.label: Live-surface test (prio 11.8, conditional)
steps.human: live-surface-tester starts a dev server, issues real HTTP requests against declared fixtures, asserts status/body/headers, then tears down — only when the ticket sets `live_surface_test: true`.

steps.label: Gated commit (prio 12)
steps.human: the commit agent shows the planned message + file list, commits under the worktree commit-phase lock, and on a pre-commit hook failure runs precommit-autofix and retries once.

steps.label: Open the pull request (prio 13)
steps.human: the pull-request agent drafts the title + body from the branch's commits, opens (or reuses) the PR, and resolves any merge conflict via conflict-resolver — on merge, control returns to the AC lifecycle's 'complete' step which marks the AC done.

branches.label: Blocker → adjudication ladder
branches.condition: a phase agent signs off with status: blocker
branches.human: when a phase returns a blocker, ticket-supervisor climbs the failure-adjudication ladder from building-epics — mechanical retry, then cross-agent rework, then brainstorm-lead, then halt — with hard retry caps, instead of advancing the chain.

acceptance_scenarios.given: a wired ticket handed over from the AC lifecycle
acceptance_scenarios.then: each NEEDED phase agent is dispatched at depth 1 in priority order and routed on its sign-off status, and not_needed agents are skipped

acceptance_scenarios.given: a ticket with a non-empty test_requirements block
acceptance_scenarios.then: failing test stubs and a red_baseline are produced for the coders to turn green

acceptance_scenarios.given: a red baseline handed over by test-writer
acceptance_scenarios.then: the production diff turns every red_baseline test green without touching files outside files_touched
every AC has implementation + test evidence before the commit lock
the AC store's work_status / implemented_by / covered_by are made accurate before commit

acceptance_scenarios.given: a committed change on the feature branch
acceptance_scenarios.then: a PR is opened (or reused) and, on merge, the AC lifecycle marks the AC done

acceptance_scenarios.given: a phase agent that returns a blocker
acceptance_scenarios.then: the failure climbs the retry → cross-agent → brainstorm-lead → halt ladder instead of advancing the chain

provenance.note: Real data-flow of the /build-feature phase chain with the agent on each step.

Corrected to the COMPLETE phase chain (18 steps): added status-checker, adr-author, architecture-diagram-author, it-po, test-runner, documentation-expert, and split the merged 'acgate' into ac-validator / user-surface-smoker / ac-fulfillment-gate / live-surface-tester.
